understanding: A position has two independent jobs: request missing information and advertise the information it already has. Separate learned transformations let those descriptions differ, while sharing the same original features.
materials_and_labels: Artificial two-feature lookup task: coordinates explicitly mean color/shape only here. A color-holding, shape-needing position has key[1,0] and query[0,1]. Another manual transform keeps[1,2] for query and swaps to[2,1] for key. Q groups two queries; K groups three keys.
expected_change: Next unit should compare each of two Q rows to all three K rows, yielding a2×3 score table; the current explanation does not require those numbers yet.
confusion_and_quote: No necessary confusion at this checkpoint. The independent need is explicit:「每個位置要找自己缺少的線索，同時讓別的位置找到自己已有的線索。」I do not infer fixed semantic axes in actual learned features.
missing_visuals: No necessary missing visual so far; two short coordinate examples identify distinct roles directly.

concept_checks.identity: Query expresses this position's request; key supplies a matching description to other positions.
concept_checks.mechanism: Different adjustable transformations of one source vector can preserve versus swap components; output representations can differ.
concept_checks.need: The stated task distinguishes what is absent from what is present, so forcing the same card for request and availability needlessly ties two different descriptions. Source states this task before the example.
concept_checks.usage: Transform original position features separately; use query against candidate keys in the already taught dot-product matching.
concept_checks.example_scope: Artificial color/shape labels make the difference in role visible; keep/swap example shows transformation feasibility. Neither establishes training success or mandatory semantic features.
concept_checks.source_quote: 分開配方，就能各自調整「提供什麼」與「要找什麼」的表示，而不要求兩者相同。
concept_checks.verdict: 已足夠; mechanism and need independently supported
